mission: Close Stage29 kernel K16-C3-EXT-C-PRIMITIVE-DIVISOR for receiver R29-EXT-CHANG-C by upgrading audited finite multiple windows to a proof for all admissible multiples, or by an equivalent deterministic closure of the same moving/thin family.

source_kernel.stage29_needed: effective odd-multiplicity primitive-divisor theorem strong enough to upgrade the audited finite windows to all multiples

current.why_first: Do not choose or cite a primitive-divisor theorem until the exact Stage29 sequence identity and required odd-multiplicity obstruction are reconstructed and source-locked.

proof_obligations.P1_exact_object: State the exact recurrence, Lucas/Lehmer/divisibility sequence, elliptic divisibility sequence, or other divisor sequence used by EXT-C; state normalization, parameters, admissible indices, degeneracies, and the exact finite windows already audited.
proof_obligations.P2_primitive_existence: Prove or source-lock a theorem giving a primitive divisor beyond an explicit effective threshold N0 for exactly that object and parameter range.
proof_obligations.P3_odd_multiplicity: Prove that at least one usable primitive divisor has odd valuation, or prove an equivalent parity/squareclass obstruction. Primitive existence alone receives no closure credit.
proof_obligations.P4_exceptional_indices: Certifiably discharge every admissible index at or below N0 and every theorem-exception/degenerate parameter case.
proof_obligations.P5_cuboid_adapter: Map the odd primitive divisor/parity fact to the exact parent-edge, gcd-factor, or representability contradiction required by R29-EXT-CHANG-C without changing population or normalization.
proof_obligations.P6_all_multiples: Conclude impossibility for every remaining admissible multiple in the same moving/thin family, not merely a searched range.

theorem_route_tree.route_A_lucas_lehmer: If P1 identifies a nondegenerate Lucas/Lehmer sequence, test Bilu-Hanrot-Voutier-style primitive divisor results first, then solve P3 separately with p-adic valuation/cyclotomic-atom analysis.
theorem_route_tree.route_B_elliptic_divisibility: If P1 identifies an elliptic divisibility sequence, use an effective elliptic-Zsigmondy/primitive-divisor theorem only after an explicit threshold is available, then prove the required valuation parity locally.
theorem_route_tree.route_C_other_recurrence: If neither A nor B applies, derive a cyclotomic/divisibility-sequence formulation and seek an effective primitive-factor theorem or a custom Thue/S-unit/local argument.
theorem_route_tree.route_D_vacuity_or_replacement: If odd multiplicity is stronger than available primitive-divisor technology, Stage34 may instead prove the Stage29 vacuity alternative: only finitely many admissible primitive-divisor-free exceptions, or another deterministic family theorem showing offending multiples cannot persist.
